rules.title: xUnit conventions
rules.text: Write tests with xUnit using Fact and Theory with InlineData.

rules.title: WebApplicationFactory
rules.text: Test HTTP endpoints with WebApplicationFactory against a real pipeline.

rules.title: Prefer fakes
rules.text: Prefer in-memory fakes or Testcontainers over mocking databases.

rules.title: Test naming
rules.text: Name tests Method_Scenario_Expected or by behavior consistently.
